Formerly believed to have been founded in 1918 the club announced in 2026 that through historical research it had been discovered that the actual founding year was 1899.{{cite web |url= https://sandvikensif.se/historiskt-beslut-pa-arsmotet-sandvikens-if-andrar-fodelsear-till-1899/ |title= Historiskt beslut på årsmötet – Sandvikens IF ändrar födelseår till 1899 |access-date=12 September 2026}} Sandvikens IF are affiliated to the [[Gestriklands Fotbollförbund]] and play their home games at [[Jernvallen]].{{cite web |url= https://svenskfotboll.se/svensk-fotboll/om-svff/distrikten/?ffid=6 |title= Distrikten Kontaktuppgifter och tävlingar – Gestriklands Fotbollförbund – Svenskfotboll.se |access-date= 10 January 2011 |archive-date= 10 December 2011 |archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20111210010735/http://svenskfotboll.se/svensk-fotboll/om-svff/distrikten/?ffid=6 |url-status= live }} The club has played 21 seasons in the top Swedish division [[Allsvenskan]] but is currently part of second tier [[Superettan]]."}}
